verdict.rationale: The axis applies, since GitHub is an issue-tracking and project-planning platform, but nothing in the evidence pack documents milestones or due dates for grouping issues. The pack only mentions issues, projects and roadmaps in general terms ('Create issues and manage projects', 'Organize everything from high-level roadmaps to everyday tasks'). Those are adjacent features and do not show milestone grouping with due dates.

support.subject: As a developer, I can group issues into milestones with due dates
